bibl.title: 1200 Years of Materialities and Editions of a Forbidden Text.
bibl.seg: Paolo Cecconi, 1200 Years of Materialities and Editions of a Forbidden Text.

Cornelia Ritter-Schmalz & Raphael Schwitter, Antike Texte und ihre Materialität. Alltägliche Präsenz, mediale Semantik, literarische Reflexion = Materiale Textkulturen. 27 (Berlin - Boston, 2019) pp. 309-330, figg.
bibl.note: Aims to investigate the influence of the lines of demarcation between "good" (canonical) and "bad" (apocryphal) texts on the transmission of one of the forbidden texts, here the Shepherd of Hermas, by analysing both its materialities and its textual history.
